description: Trigger-driven CV controller: three triggers choose between three columns of knobs, and each row of knobs sends the chosen voltage to one CV output

params.text: Sets the voltage CV A takes when Trig 1 fires
Sets the voltage CV A takes when Trig 2 fires
Sets the voltage CV A takes when Trig 3 fires
Steps through three modes: Base loads the column its trigger points at, Groove lets a held trigger block the ones after it, and ?? reads the knobs through a random sixteen-entry table
Sets the voltage CV B takes when Trig 1 fires
Sets the voltage CV B takes when Trig 2 fires
Sets the voltage CV B takes when Trig 3 fires
Sets the span of the three CV outputs: 0 to 8V on Uni, and -8V to +8V on Bi
Sets the voltage CV C takes when Trig 1 fires
Sets the voltage CV C takes when Trig 2 fires
Sets the voltage CV C takes when Trig 3 fires

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.3V loads the leftmost column of knobs into the three CV outputs, and a lamp flashes
A rising edge above 0.3V loads the middle column of knobs into the three CV outputs, and a lamp flashes
A rising edge above 0.3V loads the rightmost column of knobs into the three CV outputs, and a lamp flashes

outputs.text: Carries the voltage of whichever knob in the top row was picked last, held until the next trigger
Carries the voltage of whichever knob in the middle row was picked last, held until the next trigger
A 5V pulse whenever any of the three triggers is acted on
Carries the voltage of whichever knob in the bottom row was picked last, held until the next trigger

notes: every knob comes up at its lowest position, so all three CV outputs read 0V until the knobs are moved
the lamp beside each CV output glows green for a positive voltage and red for a negative one
